boolean:dm_reminder_disabled.label: Inactivity reminders in DMs
boolean:dm_reminder_disabled.description:
In case we detect that you didn't attend any session in {inactive_queue_days} days since you opt in, the bot will send you a reminder in your DMs. You then have 24 hours to acknowledge the reminder.

If you fail to acknowledge the reminder within 24 hours, you will be kicked from the queue.

This preference setting toggles whether these reminders will be sent into your DMs or not. Has no effect if you disabled getting DMs from CSA.

boolean:dm_notifications_disabled.label: Miscellaneous notifications in DMs
boolean:dm_notifications_disabled.description:
This preference setting toggles whether you get miscellaneous notifications, such as session cancellations in your DMs or not.

This setting does NOT affect inactivity reminders (see `Inactivity reminders in DMs` for more), and it also has no effect if you disabled getting DMs from CSA.

boolean:auto_levelup_enabled.label: Increment passed level automtically

boolean:auto_rejoin_training_queue_enabl.label: Rejoin training queue automatically
boolean:auto_rejoin_training_queue_enabl.description: Automatically rejoin the training queue after a training session you were in as a trainee concludes. Your last promotion attempt and zone will be used. If the `Increment passed level automtically` preference is enabled, the next higher level will be used (if possible).

boolean:auto_rejoin_practice_queue_enabl.label: Rejoin practice queue automatically
boolean:auto_rejoin_practice_queue_enabl.description: Automatically rejoin the practice queue after a practice session you were in as a trainee concludes. Your last zone, train amount and livefeedback will be used.

boolean_optional:live_feedback_enabled.label: Practice live feedback
boolean_optional:live_feedback_enabled.description: Preferred live feedback option when entering practice queue

boolean:queue_confirmation_disabled.label: Queue confirmation
boolean:queue_confirmation_disabled.description: Allow bot send you extra confirmation message before joining or changing queue data with summary info

level:level.label: Training promotion level
level:level.description: Preferred promotion attempt selection when entering training queue. If your preferred level isn't available, your preference will be ignored and you'll need to pick a valid promotion level

training_zone:training_zone.label: Training zone
training_zone:training_zone.description: Preferred zone selection for entering the training queue. If your preferred zone isn't available, your preference will be ignored, and you'll need to pick a new valid zone

zone:practice_zone.label: Practice zone
zone:practice_zone.description: Preferred zone when entering the practice queue

range:trains.label: Practice train amount
range:trains.description: Preferred train amount selection when entering practice queue. You can specify single number(e.g. 5), number range(e.g. 3-5) or `max`
